description: This file contains functions to calculate busy times based on booking and duration limits, integrating with various services and repositories, and exporting functions for external use.

classes.name: LimitManager
classes.description: Manages busy time periods and limits, providing methods to add busy times and retrieve current busy times.

methods.name: _getBusyTimesFromLimits
methods.description: Calculates busy times based on booking and duration limits within a date range, using performance markers for profiling.

methods.name: _getBusyTimesFromBookingLimits
methods.description: Calculates busy times based on booking limits, considering yearly limits and booking overlaps.

methods.name: _getBusyTimesFromDurationLimits
methods.description: Calculates busy times based on duration limits, considering total booking durations within periods.

methods.name: _getBusyTimesFromTeamLimits
methods.description: Calculates busy times for a team, fetching team bookings and applying limits.
